operationName: Operation Swords of Iron (Israel) / October 7 War
heroHeadline: Israel Cabinet Weighs War Resumption as Hamas Formally Rejects Disarmament Roadmap
heroSubtitle: Hamas formally rejected the UN-backed disarmament framework in Cairo on May 2, insisting it will not surrender weapons without a full Israeli withdrawal and guaranteed Palestinian statehood. Israel's security cabinet convened closed consultations on May 4 on whether to resume full-scale military operations in Gaza. Two flotilla activists (Brazilian Thiago Avila and Spanish Saif Abu Keshek) remain in Israeli custody after an Ashkelon court extended their detention May 4 amid torture allegations. Cumulative death toll: 72,587+ since Oct 7, 2023; 828+ killed since Oct 2025 ceasefire. Phase 2 talks at impasse.
footerNote: Data sourced from IDF, Hamas, UN OCHA, UNRWA, WHO, ICJ, ICC, Times of Israel, Al Jazeera, France 24, and Anadolu Agency. Gaza death toll: 72,587+ confirmed killed since Oct 7, 2023 (Gaza Ministry of Health / WAFA). 828+ killed since Oct 10, 2025 ceasefire framework per Al Jazeera Upfront (May 3, 2026). Hamas formally rejected UN/Board of Peace disarmament roadmap in Cairo (May 2, 2026); Israel's security cabinet held closed consultations on possible war resumption (May 4). Israeli court extended detention of flotilla activists Thiago Avila and Saif Abu Keshek (May 4); torture allegations detailed at Ashkelon Magistrate's Court. COGAT approved Red Cross field hospital expansion (May 2); aid trucks still at ~200/day vs. 600 required. 2026 Flash Appeal $4.1B req, only 9.7% funded. ICC arrest warrants issued for Netanyahu and Gallant (Nov 2024). Board of Peace $17B+ reconstruction fund frozen pending Hamas disarmament. EU-UN Joint Recovery and Reconstruction Assessment (Apr 21, 2026): $71.4B needed over 10 years; $35.2B infrastructure damage; 371,888 housing units damaged/destroyed; human development set back 77 years. Global Sumud Flotilla (58+ vessels from Barcelona) intercepted by IDF Apr 29–30 in international waters ~600 nautical miles from Gaza — farthest IDF interception on record. 175 activists detained; 168 disembarked in Crete (May 1); 2 held in Israel for questioning. ICRC warning: humanitarian response on verge of collapse after 2-month aid blockage from Feb 28, 2026.
